scientific_integrity: An exact five-class invariant-subspace argument and a finite-dimensional spectral absorption lemma prove the all-size theorem. The determinant identity is symbolic, and a standard-library exact-rational program independently verifies 100 finite full-graph instances. These finite checks do not establish the infinite family on their own. No independent external scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite one-particle weighted combinatorial-Laplacian dynamics; complete cliques with all internal weights one, bridge weight strictly positive, one strictly positive absorber at an ordinary vertex of the first clique, m,n >= 3. Infinite-time absorption only. Adjacency-Hamiltonian, dephasing, multi-trap and finite-time results are not established. The equal-size, unit-bridge case was analyzed previously by Razzoli, Paris and Bordone; the additional size-asymmetry classification and positive-weight universality are the focus. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed beyond examined sources.
title: An exact balance resonance in coherent absorption on two joined cliques
